comparison.objective: Candidate sets and locks a robot-gripper opening stop; PR-2209 seals a preloaded carton by peeling, paying out, applying, wrapping, and cutting tape from an ordinary loose roll.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate tests rigid two-tool screw-and-jam-nut countertorque plus articulated verification; PR-2209 tests flush tape-edge acquisition, flexible-material payout, pressure adhesion, end wrapping, and blade cutting.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate grades retained angular adjustment and repeated motion after tool withdrawal; PR-2209 grades connected tape coverage across 44 seam cells, two 35 mm end wraps, blade severing, detachment, and a two-second released seal.
comparison.reason: Flexible tape sourcing, adhesion, wrapping, and cutting test a materially different ability from maintaining a threaded stop setting during locknut tightening; PR-2209 lacks a formal task.json, full demonstration, model run, media, and validated complete-task allowance, but those omissions do not create plausible overlap.
